newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT - Commercial Bank of Korea a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Commercial Bank of Korea a "buy".

text.p: ING Barings Securities said on Thursday it has upgraded its recommendations for Commerical Bank of Korea to "buy" from "trading buy" because of its good earnings outlook.
The Seoul branch of the securities house said the bank was helped by improved asset quality, sound valuations and cuts in the central Bank of Korea's reserve requirements.
The bank's net earnings rose 15.2 percent to 106 billion won in calendar 1996 with smaller stock valuation losses and bad loan provisions, ING Barings said in a report.
The securities house forecast the bank's profit would rise to 135 billion won in 1997 and to 158 billion in 1998.
ING Barings predicted earnings per share would rise to 794 won this year and to 928 won by 1998, against 1996's 621 won.
